split_design: Published DS1/DS2 record scheme adapted to existing 42-record scope: exclude 201 because same subject as test 202; exclude 207 because current pool has no defined VF handling. DS1 remaining 20: four fixed validation records 115/118/205/220, remaining 16 train. This is NOT the exact published split or a fresh whole-system holdout; all 42 previously inspected in QRS research. Validation selection used annotation support audit, never CNN scores.

excluded_records.207: VF contract not defined in current record pool

excluded_labels: Unmapped Q and non-beat annotations do not become N. Beat positions including Q still update prior RR history. No beat removed based on model result.

window.normalization: Within this complete 180-point beat only: resample, subtract mean, divide max(std,0.05mV). No whole-record statistics. Exclude incomplete edges and first beat without preceding RR; do not pad missing ECG at record EOF.

rr.startup: If no earlier interval, means equal current preRR. Means otherwise exclude current interval.

model.status: Independent adaptation of fixed-template MF Conv1D + shared interval MLP + softmax. Not official code/weights or exact paper reproduction.
model.kernels: Four TRAIN-only superclass mean beat templates, center32, L2 normalized; frozen
model.morphology: SAME crosscorrelation stride1 left15/right16; globalmax; TRAIN-only feature standardization; tanh
differences: four superclass templates rather than paper subclass templates
causal three RR features rather than four pre/post features
fixed train-only feature standardization rather than trainable BatchNorm
frozen convolution; only RR MLP and head optimized

training.class_weight: sqrt(n_train/(4*n_class)), normalized to mean training sample weight 1
training.selection: maximum validation macro-F1, ties lower unweighted validation cross entropy; never select using test

evaluation.undefined_class_metric: zero with support shown; macro averages all 4 target classes
evaluation.test_policy: one final evaluation after validation selection; any later tuning makes this known-data exploratory evidence
evaluation.acceptance: This first run establishes a reproducible baseline; no promised accuracy. No clinical/FPGA/INT8 acceptance inferred.

scope: expert annotation centered classifier, not detected-beat end-to-end system
